blocks.text: A home network connects the different devices in a house, so that computers, mobile phones and printers can communicate with each other and share the same Internet connection. The router is the main device in a home network. Setting up the network makes data sharing easy and fast, and proper configuration improves its speed and safety.

items: Router: connects all the devices in the network.
Modem: connects the home network to the Internet Service Provider.
Network devices: computers, laptops and mobile phones.
Network cables for wired connections; Wi-Fi signals for wireless devices.

blocks.caption: Wired and wireless connections
rows: Ethernet cables, directly to a router or switch
Radio signals; Wi-Fi is the most common technology in homes
Can be slower than wired in some cases
Devices cannot move freely because of the cables
Devices can move freely within range; easy to install and use
